lines.text: oh can a stone help that it's cold
cause it's not on the sunny side of the mountain
and how can i not fold
to the ebb and flow of your shouting
i will rock as a boat on the tides of your moods
and watch as you spit to the shore all the fools
no longer will i try to change your will
instead i'll try staying blissfully still
so if it's true it's not the stone's fault
where mother earth spat her sediment
if your wrath pure is too hot
to my apple won't you be the cinnamon
i don't mean to offend
i will keep to myself
both stone cold, boiling hot, in control, overwhelmed
perhaps i'll try staying blissfully still
in fact, i'm pretty sure that i will
and so can i help i'm a breeze
i had hoped you might be refreshed by
could i have known yous skin breaks with such ease
when i thought i was just blowing by
i meant no insult
i'm just cool by design
and it's nobody's fault you can't see my inside
perhaps i'll try staying blissfully still
in fact i'm more than sure that i will
and cease rubbing sand in your gills
and thrusting thorns in your sides
swaying still is likely most wise
